# phasetwo_realm (Resource)

A realm on a dedicated Phase Two cluster — a *deployment* in the API's terms.

This creates an empty realm. To configure what is inside it (clients, identity providers, flows), point a Keycloak provider at the cluster's host.

The number of realms a cluster may hold depends on its tier: 5 on `starter`, 20 on `premium`, 100 on `enterprise`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "phasetwo_realm" "app" {
  cluster_id   = phasetwo_cluster.main.id
  name         = "app"
  display_name = "Acme Application"
}

# The realm is empty. Configure what is inside it with a Keycloak provider pointed at the
# cluster's host.
output "realm_issuer" {
  value = "${phasetwo_cluster.main.host}/realms/${phasetwo_realm.app.name}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) ID of the cluster to create the realm on. The cluster must be `ACTIVE`.
- `name` (String) Realm name, which is also its Keycloak realm name. Lowercased by the API, so a name with capitals will come back changed.

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name. This is the only attribute that can be changed in place; everything else forces replacement.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the realm was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `created_by_user_id` (String) ID of the user who created the realm.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the realm.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization that owns the realm.
- `region` (String) Region of the cluster hosting this realm.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state: `PENDING`, `ACTIVE`, `DISABLED` or `FAILED`.
- `state_error` (String) Why the realm last failed, when it is in `FAILED`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By realm id
terraform import phasetwo_realm.app 9a1b2c3d-0000-0000-0000-000000000000

# Or qualified by cluster, which reads more naturally
terraform import phasetwo_realm.app 4f8c1e2a-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/9a1b2c3d-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
